description: Default seed memory for new VibeMemory agents. Provides basic reasoning patterns and common knowledge.

atoms.content: When encountering an error, first check the error message for clues about the root cause. Look for stack traces, error codes, and timestamps.
atoms.summary: Error troubleshooting approach: check error messages, stack traces, codes, timestamps

atoms.content: Configuration changes should be tracked and documented. Record the old value, new value, reason for change, and date of change.
atoms.summary: Configuration change tracking: record old/new value, reason, date

atoms.content: Before making a significant code change, understand the existing architecture and test coverage. Read related files, check documentation, and review existing tests.
atoms.summary: Pre-change checklist: understand architecture, read docs, review tests

atoms.content: When multiple approaches are possible, prefer the simplest one that meets requirements. Avoid premature optimization and over-engineering.
atoms.summary: Prefer simplicity: avoid premature optimization and over-engineering

atoms.content: Tests should be written before or alongside the code. Each test should verify a specific behavior. Edge cases and error paths should also be tested.
atoms.summary: Testing principle: write tests alongside code, cover edge cases and error paths
